scenes.source_text: The film opens on a lighthouse perched on jagged rocks at the edge of the sea.
Its beam sweeps endlessly through sheets of torrential rain.
Waves slam against the rocks, surging nearly to the height of the tower.
Thunder crashes overhead, deafening.
The night is as terrifying as it gets.
We see a 8-month-pregnant middle-aged woman, in glasses, Shreelatha, talking to her husband on the telephone.
It's a landline.

SHREELATHA:
Aap ne khana khaya?

VOICE ON THE PHONE (Concerned):
Ha… tum jaldi niklo… mausam aur bhi bighadne wala hai!
A thunderous crash abruptly interrupts their conversation. She rubs her eyes.

SHREELATHA (assuring):
Nikalti hoo… Bas reliver aata hi hoga…

VOICE ON THE PHONE:
Mujhe fikar ho rahi hai…

SHREELATHA:
Kyu fikar karte ho… Raju hai mere saath…
She continues speaking on the phone, her gaze drifting to the sea.
A pink light blooms around her, intensifying.
Her eyes flare wide with disbelief.
A colossal bolt of thunder crashes into the lighthouse.
Sparks burst violently — BOOM. Total darkness.
The image fades out.
We see Shreelatha in active labor.
Outside the ICU, her husband paces anxiously, also in glasses, rubbing his eyes, her screams echoing through the corridor.
Suddenly, the screams stop.
He turns towards the delivery room.
Shreelatha looks at him — emotional, exhausted.
Her husband is overwhelmed.
The doctor is holding the newborn upside down - pats the baby's bottom to make him cry.
On contact, a beam shoots from the baby's eyes, blasting through the ICU door.
Everyone freezes, staring at the ruined doorway in disbelief.
Fade out.
🎬 TITLE APPEARS ON BLACK SCREEN : THE LASER MAN & THE EYE OF POWER
A luxury yacht glides across tranquil waters.
Music pounds. Glasses clink. Guests dance.
Suddenly, the sea begins to churn. A vortex is created.
A PARTYGOER stops dancing and looks outside.
BOOM!
A massive tentacle erupts from the ocean.
Another tentacle bursts free. Then another.
A giant octopus rises from the depths, bellowing.
VFX: A trump card appears on a freeze frame of the creature showcasing its strengths and weaknesses.
Panic explodes as people scatter.
One tentacle swings toward the yacht.
ZZZAAAAAP!
A blinding white laser slices it clean off.
Silence. Everyone looks at the direction of the laser.
We reveal our superhero—hovering mid-air in a classic hero pose.
We see his POV. It's blurry.
He shoots another laser that misses the Octopus.
Lazer rubs his eyes. Shoots again.
Another tentacle drops into the sea.
The octopus retreats beneath the waves.
The crowd ERUPTS.
Soon as the Laser Man lands, reporters swarm him.

LASER MAN (smiles):
Umm… Regular day at work.

LASER MAN (takes a moment):
Ofcourse. There was fog.

LASER MAN(squints):
No spoilers!
Match cut to TV that plays the news footage.
A middle aged man is watching it in his drawing room.
Vyom walks in with a phone in his hand.
They sit together and laugh.
Grandfather puts on his glasses.
As he says Hypermetropia - we hear a music beat.
Vyom is transported to a surreal space with a huge human eye.

MUSICAL:
JAB DOOR DIKHTA SAAF SAAF
PAR CLOSE KO BLUR KIYA
Vyom comes back to the living room a little confused.
The Grandfather takes off his glasses and starts narrating the story.
Flashback : A toddler watches a cat stalk a dove.

ZZZAAAAAP!
A laser beam is fired to distract the cat.
We cut to him, now a little grown-up. 10-years-old.
The laser man gives them a stern look.
He takes a deep breath and shoots three beams one after the other.
Their pants come off. The entire school laughs.
We cut to the Laser Man—older now, in college.
While everyone struggles to light the grill—ZZZAAAAAP!
Aur ek din… uski zindagi Badal gayi.
Paper Caper struck… without any mercy.
Humara Lazer fight mein kood pada!
Ek single moment mein… Paper Caper erase ho gaya.
Vyom's eyes light up!

INT. VYOM'S ROOM
We see Vyom in his room.
Match cut to Lazer's eyes in his room. He looks at the ceiling.
A montage of the Lazer defeating various villains, in comic book style images.
In one of the situations, we will show him rubbing his eyes after shooting a laser.
Vyom looks at the TV and then he squints his eyes.
He opens the book with the chapter of the human eye.
He is transported to the surreal space.
Once it is fully constructed - we leave the space.
A round table conference of the villains of Fatorda.
The SUPER BOSS is online.
Yeh ek SOS device hai…
Everyone in the room looks excited by this idea.

INT. SURREAL SPACE CONT'D.
The huge 3D human eye in front of Vyom.

A man comes out.
Optometrist:
We see the Cornea part of the human eye glowing in the surreal space.

INT. VYOM'S ROOM
Vyom is sleeping in his room with the book lying near him.
FADE IN - EXT. BIRTHDAY – NIGHT
The Laser Man bends down to blow the candle.
A GIANT OWL swoops down.
VFX: NAME: OZZY THE OWL
Laser Man locks his gaze on the Owl's life crystal.

BLOP!
The beam misses the crystal.
The owl bursts into EVIL LAUGHTER.
INT. TV NEWS MONTAGE

INT. VYOM'S ROOM
He is watching TV and gets really sad.
He opens the book and is in the surreal space again.
We see the Iris and Pupil part of the human eye glowing in the surreal space.
Vyom has slept again in his room.
Laser Man charges into battle against a towering new monster.
He fires. Misses.
Fires again—misses.
He experiences some discomfort in his eyes.
The monster overpowers him.
Laser Man crashes to the ground.
From the rubble, he watches the city burn—buildings collapsing, fires raging—unable to act.
Crowds gather in the streets, pointing, shouting.
BOOS rise, growing louder, merciless.
On phones. On screens.
Laser Man's defeat turns into viral memes.
Even the monsters revel in it—posing, celebrating, mocking the fallen hero.

MEMES:
1. The blue tick disappears from his profile.
2. Laser Man is used as a scarecrow.
3. Laser makes a superhero landing: KRISSH KA SUNEGA GAANA?
4. Laser Man is getting slapped by multiple villains.
5. His face is morphed on the face of a dancing husky.
6. Laser Man asking a shopkeeper: yeh 10 rupayee ka biscuit ka packet kitne ko diya?
Lazer looks at the reporters outside his house as he is sadly looking out his window.
Vyom watches it on his phone.
His face fades into quiet disappointment.
He opens the chapter of the human eye on his phone.
We cut to the surreal space.
This time we intercut the song in his house and the surreal space.
Crystalline Lens Vyom, hai jaise glass,
OpticNerve rasta hai, ye bhi bada great,
The song ends here.
A towering billboard dominates the city skyline in front of his room: "EVEN THE LASER MAN NEEDS LASIK!"
Lazer looks at this and mumbles to himself.
Is sheher ko meri ab koi zaroorat nahi.
He takes out his suitcase.
We cut to see him without his superhero dress outside his room door.
WE SEE THE CONFERENCE ROOM THE VILLAINS AGAIN. THEY ARE LAUGHING.
WE SEE MULTIPLE SHOTS OF THEM ATTACKING THE CITY.
THE KIDS RUNNING. THE ADULTS PROTECTING THEIR KIDS.
VYOM WATCHES ALL OF THIS ON HIS PHONE.
FINALLY, HE MAKES A RESOLVED FACE AND SNEAKS OUT OF HIS HOUSE AT NIGHT.
Laser Man sits alone in the dim light. Unshaven. Overweight. Eyes hollow.
A KNOCK at the door.
Standing there is Vyom.
Your biggest fan!
The city needs you!
Dafaa ho jao yaha se!

Situation 1:
Laser Man opens the curtains, finds Vyom standing outside the window.

Situation 2:
Laser Man orders pizza.

Situation 3:
Laser Man steps into a shower.

Situation 4:
Laser Man is watering the plants.

Situation 5:
Vyom knocks on his door.
Vyom takes out a prism from his pocket.
Vyom lifts his hand and the laser enters the prism and after refraction tags something else.
Ye kaise hua?
Bina baarish ka rainbow dekhoge?
As he makes way for sunlight to enter the prism, a rainbow-like structure is formed on the table.
Then Vyom switches on the TV in his room.
A monster is attacking the city.
We see Lazer's face for a few moments. We zoom in. And then he looks at Vyom and nods.
We cut to them standing in front of an eye clinic which has the same banner.
They look at each other and enter.
The OPTOMETRIST freezes on seeing the Laser Man.

OPTOMETRIST (freaked out):
Laser Bhai!!!

LAZER MAN (striking a heroic pose, beams glinting in his eyes):
Aap ki ad itni badhiya hai…
Before he can finish, the OPTOMETRIST collapses into a chair, waving his arms like a windmill.
Vyom walks in calmly, hands behind his back, like a master strategist.

VYOM:
Theek hai… Theek hai… inka eye check up karana hai!
The optometrist mutes the audio. Now, it's like a sing-song.

OPTOMETRIST (looking at Lazer):
Aapne apni aankhon ko kabhi maintainance hi nahi kiya.

LASER MAN:
Ankhon ka maintenance bhi hota hai?
The optometrist points at the eye testing chart and starts explaining.

OPTOMETRIST:
JAB FAR HAI SAAF SAAF
PAR CLOSE KO BLUR KAR DIYA

LASER MAN:
CLOSE CLOSE NO FEAR
PAR DOOR KA HAI UNCLEAR?

OPTOMETRIST:
AAP KO HAI… MYOPIA DEAR!
The optometrist explains far point and healthy eye vision.

OPTOMETRIST:
Abhi aapka eye lens light ko retina ke aage converge kar raha hain...
While the optometrist is explaining the above, we show the Optometrist, Vyom and Lazer all in the surreal space.
Laser Man looks at him extremely confused.

LASER MAN:
Acchhaa, aur agar Hypoo hota toh...??

VYOM:
To convex lenses lagate!
Cut to : CONT. INSIDE THE LAB
The OPTOMETRIST sits Laser Man down for an eye exam.

OPTOMETRIST (curious):
Kya aap ka screen time jyaada hai?

OPTOMETRIST:
Tumhara excessive usage of lasers.
One by one, the optometrist slides different lenses into the testing machine.
Laser Man stares ahead, blinking, struggling to focus.

OPTOMETRIST:
Ab dikhaee de raha hai?

OPTOMETRIST:
The power of accommodation takes time…

OPTOMETRIST (pointing at a 3D eye diagram):
Tumhari aankh ek camera ke jaise kaam karti hai…

LASER MAN (wide-eyed, dramatic gasp):
Lens ka shape change hota hai?

OPTOMETRIST:
Human Eye ki issi ability ko kehte hain Power of Accommodation.

OPTOMETRIST:
Ab?

LASER MAN (super excited):
Ha!
And in excitement he shoots a laser beam.

BOOM!
The entire lab disappears.

LASER MAN:
Sorry… Main vo thoda excite ho gaya!

OPTOMETRIST:
Aap mat aana bhai… Main bhijwa dunga!
Laser Man slips on his new glasses.
He plants his feet, taking aim at a row of bottles.

VFX: ZZZAAAAAP!
Every bottle explodes into shards.
Vyom tosses an apple towards him.

LASER MAN (smiles):
I owe you one!
We cut to Fatorda's annual festival.
A piercing hoot cuts through the noise.
The OWL RETURNS.
A figure descends from above. The Laser Man.
Freeze frame of a stand-off between the owl and laser man.
A direct hit—the beam strikes the life crystal dead center.
The OWL emits a piercing SOS call.
From every direction, the rest of the villains arrive.
After a brief stand-off, the final fight erupts.
Enter SLEDGEHAMMER.
Laser Man dodges every punch.
Laser Man hands Sledgehammer a visiting card.
PART 2 - GLITCHER
Glitcher throws smoke bombs and distorts his image.
Vyom explains refraction using smoke and light.
The Laser Man shoots and defeats the Glitcher.
PART 3 - SANDMAN
Sandman pins the Laser Man against a wall.
Vyom notices sunlight filtering through trees.
Vyom explains the Tyndall effect.
Laser Man fires a high-intensity laser at Sandman.
Sandman shreds into countless dust particles.
Laser Man scatters the dust with laser beams.
Laser Man ruptures a water tank, dissolving Sandman.
The SOS device is destroyed.
News tickers flash: "THE HERO IS BACK!"

LASER MAN:
No! We did it!
Vyom and the Laser Man fly together.
They stand before a massive rainbow.
Vyom explains rainbow formation in voiceover.
They walk toward the lighthouse at sunset.
Eightdrian attacks again from the sea.
Laser Man defeats Eightdrian with a final blast.
Vyom explains atmospheric refraction and twinkling stars.
A pink light approaches the lighthouse.

BOOM!!!
The pink beam strikes the lighthouse.
CUT TO BLACK. END SCENE.

INT RENOVATED CLINIC
SLEDGEHAMMER sits for an eye exam.
The optometrist explains near point and hypermetropia.
Sledgehammer puts on convex lens spectacles.
He exits the clinic leaving destruction behind.
